narrative:
The AI rolling forecast puts FY2027 revenue at GBP 3.79B, GBP 9M below plan and 6.0% above FY2026. The feature-enhanced model, trained on claims inflation, NHS waiting lists, corporate renewals and dental utilisation, runs at 2.4% MAPE against about 4.3% for the manual Oracle EPM forecast.

The scenario range is ±GBP 62M. The downside is medical inflation two points above plan; the upside is NHS waiting lists staying above 7 million for the whole year. FX on Bupa Global is the largest single sensitivity.

This is where a sceptical leadership team can test the AI: every forecast line shows its drivers, and planners can override any cell with the reason captured. The forecast refreshes weekly instead of monthly.

signals.title: Bupa Global FX Sensitivity
signals.excerpt: International premiums are largely USD-linked; a 1.32 USD/GBP rate reduces sterling revenue by about GBP 16M versus plan rates.

signals.title: Local Authority Care Fee Uplifts 2027
signals.excerpt: Fee uplifts confirmed at 6.5% in Scotland and Wales and around 5% in England, ahead of the 4% assumed in the draft plan.

signals.title: NHS Elective Waiting List Above 7 Million
signals.excerpt: Referral-to-treatment waiting times continue to drive self-pay and PMI demand for diagnostics, orthopaedics and cataract procedures.
